'''Operation Shieldfall''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] in [[44 ABY]] that resulted in a battle between the forces of the [[New Jedi Order]], the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]]. After their tenuous [[Mission to the Maw|alliance]] to destroy Abeloth was [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|broken]], both the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Sith pursued Abeloth&mdash;who had caused a [[Force psychosis|psychosis]] amongst the Jedi. [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]], along with Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], tracked Abeloth to Nam Chorios, where they met the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Theran Listener]]s and discovered that the [[Theran]]s had fallen under Abeloth's control. Khai sent a message to her [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Gavar Khai|Gavar]], who led a Sith [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|flotilla]] to the planet. After searching for Abeloth in various locations and being [[First duel in Kesla Vein|attacked]] [[Second duel in Kesla Vein|twice]] by Sith under the command of [[Sith Saber|Saber]] [[Tola Annax]], Vestara and the Skywalkers located Abeloth in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Crystal Valley (Nam Chorios)|Crystal Valley]].

In a [[Crystal Valley pumping station|pumping station]] there, they found the psychotic Jedi [[Valin Horn]] with Abeloth, who was in the guise of former Jedi [[Callista Ming]]. Luke successfully [[Mnemotherapy|extracted]] Ming's spirit from the entity, and the [[Master of the Theran Listeners]], [[Nenn]], whom Abeloth had also possessed, committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]], severely weakening Abeloth. Horn lost consciousness, and Vestara and the Skywalkers were immediately ambushed by a group of Sith. Vestara killed one of the planet's [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]], a [[tsil]], resulting in a major [[death convulsion]] that further weakened Abeloth and gave Vestara and the Skywalkers time to flee the area with Horn. Meanwhile, Gavar's forces had arrived in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], where they were ambushed by a Jedi [[StealthX]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] wing that had been called in by Luke days previously. Upon rendezvousing with the Jedi forces, Luke [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] one of the StealthXs in pursuit of Abeloth, who fled in the [[Sith Meditation Sphere|meditation sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]]. The Sith flotilla sustained heavy damage from the Jedi and was forced to retreat, but Luke was hit before he could destroy Ship, and Abeloth escaped. As Luke recovered from his injuries and the Sith regrouped, Abeloth contacted the Sith fleet and proposed an alliance to defeat the Jedi.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|There are fewer enmities more ancient than that of Sith and Jedi.''"<br />"''This thing we both fight might be older than that.|Luke Skywalker and Sarasu Taalon|<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Luke-Allies.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Exiled Jedi Grand Master Luke Skywalker]]
In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] began to contract a [[Force psychosis]] that caused them to believe that everyone they knew had been replaced by impostors.<ref name="Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref> Meanwhile, [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] ordered the arrest of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who was put on [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Luke Skywalker|trial]] and [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] for his inability to prevent [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]]' fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Luke took the opportunity to retrace the steps of the five-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] journey Caedus had taken after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in hopes of finding out why he had turned to the dark side. Skywalker's son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], accompanied him on his travels.<ref name="Outcast" />

They eventually [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|encountered]] a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] from the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] at a [[Sinkhole Station|space station]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. They also met the dark side entity [[Abeloth]], whom they speculated was causing the psychosis.<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref> After tracking the strike team's sole surviving member, [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]], to the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], they were convinced by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], led by [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]], to ally for a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to destroy Abeloth. Although the alliance was a [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|ploy]] by the Sith, the Jedi survived the Sith's betrayal and defeated Abeloth.<ref name="Allies" /> The alliance was temporarily restored, but after discovering that Abeloth had not actually [[Death/Legends|died]] it again dissolved into [[Duel at the Pool of Knowledge|violence]]. The Skywalkers, with Khai in tow, tracked Abeloth to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pydyr]] and again [[Battle in the Fallanassi village|confronted]] her. During the battle, Khai killed Taalon, who had begun to transform into another Abeloth-like being, and Abeloth was again forced to flee.<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref> Fearing that the Sith would not take the time to learn the reasoning behind her action and would only see it as a betrayal, Khai left the planet with the Skywalkers, who used a [[blood trail]] established by Luke to track Abeloth to the planet [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]].<ref name="Conviction" />

[[File:Ben_and_Vestara.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ben Skywalker and Vestara Khai]]
There, the group met with former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Taselda]]. Luke informed her of Abeloth and soon after learned the [[Force power/Legends|technique]] of [[mnemotherapy]]&mdash;with which one was able to withdraw and eradicate memories from another being&mdash;from [[Listener-Master]] [[Taru Durn]]. As Khai and the Skywalkers continued to hunt for Abeloth, they were ambushed by the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], who was under the control of Abeloth. When one of the [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Golan III Space Defense NovaGun]]s fired down on them, it missed and hit a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] known as a [[tsil]], resulting in a [[death convulsion]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that caused Ship to flee.<ref name="Conviction" />

Upon their return to the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hweg Shul]], they discovered that Abeloth had possessed the [[Master of the Theran Listeners]], [[Nenn]], and taken over the Listeners themselves. Vestara sent a secret message to her [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Gavar Khai|Gavar]], in order to alert him of the situation, unknowingly playing into Master Skywalker's plans&mdash;he had arranged several days previously for a flight of Jedi [[StealthX]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to lie await in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], hoping to lure the Sith there so that the starfighters could ambush them. As Khai and the Skywalkers began to investigate Abeloth's possible locations, they were [[First duel in Kesla Vein|ambushed]] in the town of [[Kesla Vein]] by a Sith party led by [[Sith Saber]] [[Tola Annax]]. After defeating the Sith, the group was contacted by [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Kandra Nilitz]], who had brought the psychotic Jedi [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn]] to the planet in return for the promise of finding a good story. Luke convinced her to meet with him, but once Khai and the Jedi arrived at Nilitz's [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] they were again [[Second duel in Kesla Vein|ambushed]] by Sith. After fighting off the Sith and informing the reporter about Abeloth and the Tribe, Khai and the Skywalkers made their way to the city of [[Crystal Valley (Nam Chorios)|Crystal Valley]] to confront Abeloth.<ref name="Conviction" />

==The operation==
{{Quote|Luke&hellip;Join with me. Save me.&hellip;''"<br />"''I will. I will save you.|Ming's presence in Abeloth and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Conviction" />}}
[[File:Callista.png|thumb|left|150px|Callista Ming, whose spirit was finally released]]
At the [[Crystal Valley pumping station]] they discovered that Abeloth was draining the Theran Listeners and that the psychotic Jedi Knight [[Valin Horn]] had come to Abeloth's aid. He led them to an illusion conjured by Abeloth, in the form of Luke's former lover, [[Callista Ming]]. Abeloth tried to appeal to Luke's past love for Ming and requested that he join her. However, Luke was able to sense Abeloth's consciousness trying to hide behind Ming, and Ming begged for Luke to save her. He initiated the mnemotherapy technique on Ming while [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]] erupted outside the cave&mdash;the Sith had arrived and entered battle with Abeloth there. Horn, believing that the Jedi had brought reinforcements, attacked Ben and Khai. Although Horn was outnumbered, he had more combat experience and was able to hold them off. Meanwhile, Luke succeeded in ripping Ming's spirit from Abeloth's possession; Ming was freed from Abeloth's control and allowed to pass on into the Force. Abeloth's body then morphed into that of the [[Master of the Theran Listeners]], [[Nenn]], whom she had also consumed. Rather than allowing Abeloth to control him, however, Nenn killed himself, weakening Abeloth to the point where she could no longer control Horn&mdash;who fell unconscious&mdash;and causing her to flee.<ref name="Conviction" />

Before Khai and the Jedi could follow, however, the group was ambushed by at least two dozen Sith, once again led by Annax. The Sith had them surrounded, and realizing that it would only be a matter of time before they were killed, Khai decided to repulse the Sith by killing a tsil. As they dueled, she warned the Skywalkers of an imminent massive [[Force power/Legends|Force attack]], and began counting down. After ten seconds, she killed the tsil, and a tremendous death convulsion hit the area, causing both Luke and Khai to drop to their knees and stunning the Sith. Khai and the Jedi were the first to recover, and Ben carried the unconscious Horn while Khai helped Luke leave the station. Luke was troubled that she had killed a tsil, but Khai rationalized that Luke was the only being who could defeat Abeloth, and that meant that he had to survive.<ref name="Conviction" />

[[File:GavarKhai-Allies.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Sith Saber Gavar Khai]]
Gavar Khai, now in command of a flotilla of [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector]] [[ChaseMaster|frigates]], had sent advance agents to take control of the planet's orbiting [[Golan III Space Defense NovaGun]]s, and had succeeded to do so in all but one. As he arrived in orbit, however, his fleet was ambushed by the Jedi's StealthXs. Meanwhile, Khai and the Skywalkers emerged from the cave and into the war zone. After being questioned by Khai, Luke admitted that he had planned the whole scenario, drawing the Sith to Nam Chorios so they would be ambushed by the Jedi. Luke contacted the closest StealthX, piloted by [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and after commandeering Jedi Knight [[Tyria Sarkin Tainer|Tyria Tainer's]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], he joined the battle. The Sith fleet quickly suffered heavy damage, and Khai was forced to call a retreat. Meanwhile, Skywalker pursued Abeloth, who was fleeing in Ship.<ref name="Conviction" />

Skywalker&mdash;whose exile had finally been revoked following a [[Plan Delta|coup]] that removed Daala from her [[Office of the Chief of State|office]]&mdash;led [[Gray Squadron (New Jedi Order)|Gray Squadron]] in pursuit of Ship. [[Gold Squadron (New Jedi Order)|Gold Squadron's]] [[Raynar Thul]] was hit by one of the NovaGuns and forced to eject from his starfighter, but he was nevertheless able to detonate a [[Jedi shadow bomb|shadow bomb]] he had launched near Ship. Both Abeloth and Ship were damaged and Luke took the opportunity to score a hit on Ship with his [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], before he himself was shot down by the NovaGun. The rest of the StealthXs abandoned their pursuit of Abeloth and focused on drawing fire away from Luke, who was rescued along with Thul.<ref name="Conviction" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I have heard the arguments for continuing to work closely with her, and the arguments to sever ties. While I confess I am not overly fond of the former, and have made little secret of my opinion, neither do I think it is time for the latter. The best way to win is to cover all angles of the situation. And so Kesh and the Circle of Lords will invite Abeloth to our world. We shall give her a grand welcome, with feasting, and arts, and displays of our proud and powerful culture. And, we will watch, and learn, and listen.|Darish Vol|<ref name="Ascension" />}}
The Jedi recuperated on the Galactic Alliance [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] [[Verity (Galactic Alliance)|''Verity'']], where Luke was able to recover in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]]. Although injured and severely weakened, Abeloth was able to escape from Nam Chorios in Ship. While the Sith fleet regrouped, Abeloth contacted Gavar Khai and stated her belief that they could not defeat their mutual enemy&mdash;the Jedi&mdash;alone,<ref name="Conviction" /> and she bid for an alliance with the Sith. The Tribe's [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]] then ordered Gavar to bring her back to the Tribe's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] to confer with the Tribe's [[Circle of Lords|leadership]]. There, Vol agreed to allow Abeloth to travel down to the surface, so that they could observe her and then decide whether or not to accept her offer for an alliance. However, Abeloth soon launched an attack against the Grand Lord, and when her attempt on his life failed and left her in agony, she [[Destruction of Tahv|destroyed]] much of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]] with Force energy. Gavar Khai then broke his bonds with the Tribe and led those Sith who chose to remain loyal to Abeloth in a retreat from the world.<ref name="Ascension" />

==Behind the scenes==
Operation Shieldfall appeared in [[Aaron Allston]]'s third and final novel in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series&mdash;and the seventh of nine installments overall&mdash;''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]'', released [[May 24]], [[2011]].
